items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Drag had left with George Lewis.

ctx.x: It was Lawrence Murray's band, was it?

Yeah, it was Lawrence Murray. He couldn't go on to George Lewis' title because it was an organized band. But George, George Rosenthal told him, let's get him a good city. But he know most of the men's coming up there because he was down here. He came down here when we even was working at the paddock. Then we made another group. We come out the paddock, we made another group. When George, one time George Lewis split his band. Some of these men that won't go on the road like, such as Jim Crow and Kid Howard, with…
Well, uh, Bro. Well, uh, Bro.
